advisories.basis: S-6 is marked '구현 전 RED' (red before implementation), but its 방법·환경 (method/environment) column is 'pytest / 두 도구 및 실제 Codex sandbox', which mixes in a real Codex sandbox. What S-6 promises can all be shown by injecting EPERM/EACCES/EROFS into the lock `os.open` and the registry write: errors classified as `registry_write_denied` with no 30-second wait, `ok` plus the `registry_owner_deferred_to_hub` diagnostic returned only after a successful lease, and a foreign owner still failing. No acceptance criterion here depends on a model's judgment. The real-environment check of AC-4 with the actual permission boundary is already covered by S-9 (installed copy, real Orca/Codex, codex-start ok, lease owner equals registry owner). The S-6 row has no `[실호출 1회]` (one real call) marker.
advisories.recommendation: Limit S-6 to pytest fault injection across the two tools and codex-start. Drop the 'real Codex sandbox' environment from S-6, or move it into S-9's setup as a single real-permission check, so the RED run before implementation has no real-environment dependency.
